csv_project_name: CM Service for Trail Design Engrg Inspection Maint & Bridge
csv_agency: County of El Dorado Department of Transportation
csv_scope_of_work: The County s Procurement and Contracts Division, on behalf of all County departments, is soliciting sealed Statements of Qualifications (SOQ) from highly qualified and experienced firms (hereinafter referred to as Respondent or firm ) to provide as-needed and urgent or immediate bridge, road, and trail design, engineering, inspection, maintenance, and bridge construction management services. Firms must have and demonstrate their experience in providing the services identified herein (experience with California local governments is desirable). The purpose of this Request for Qualifications (RFQ) is to establish a qualified list (hereinafter referred to as QL ) of qualified and experienced firms to provide as-needed and urgent or immediate bridge, road, and trail design, engineering, inspection, maintenance, and bridge construction management services. The County makes no specific guarantee as to a minimum or maximum number of successful Respondents that will be named to the resulting QL, which shall be valid for a maximum period of three (3) years from the date of the award.
csv_disciplines_requested: Civil Engineering, Geotechnical Engineering, Construction/Project Management, Inspection Services, Structural Engineering, Traffic Design Engineering

title: Construction Management Service for Trail Design, Engineering, Inspection, Maintenance and Bridge
short_description: Framework RFQ for as-needed bridge, road, and trail design and construction management services.

services: Establishment of a qualified list for as-needed civil engineering, structural engineering, geotechnical engineering, inspection services, traffic design engineering, and construction/project management related to bridge, road, and trail design, engineering, inspection, maintenance, and bridge construction management.
relevance_explanation:
- Includes bridge-related engineering and structural engineering services.
- However, this is a broad as-needed framework/qualified list without defined technical scope or specific structures.
- Covers many non-core disciplines such as geotechnical, traffic, inspection, and project management.
- Explicitly resembles a framework agreement for multiple bridges, which is generally not preferred, especially without technical specification.
- No information on spans, structural complexity, innovation, sustainability, or architecturally demanding content.
construction_cost_explanation: No construction cost is stated in the source. No specific project, bridge size, span, quantity, or construction package is defined, so a realistic estimate is not possible. Only a 3-year as-needed qualified list for bridge, road, and trail related services is described.
fee_explanation: No fee information is stated. Because this is a multi-year qualified list without defined task orders, project sizes, or estimated call-off volumes, a realistic sbp fee estimate is not possible.
references_qualifications: Firms must be highly qualified and experienced and demonstrate experience in the requested services. Experience with California local governments is desirable.
contracting_authority: County of El Dorado, Department of Transportation, Procurement and Contracts Division, Placerville, CA, USA. Contact: Tyler Prince. Email: tyler.prince@edcgov.us. Phone: 530-621-6438.
notes: Project No. 2026-0133. RFQ to establish a qualified list with no guaranteed minimum or maximum number of selected firms. Contract duration/base period: 36 months, non-renewable. Questions deadline: 07/17/2026 05:00 PM PDT. Solicitation documents available by contact.
